root: ^I plug the strange USB disk into my dad's computer.
^The screen flashes with a dark blue, and red binary streams down.
^???: My, it's been a while, Albert.
^???: Oh! I see that you are Albert's successor!
^???: Might I ask your name, good sir!

WHO: ^???: Who am I? I am not a 'who'. I cannot be encompassed by 'who'.
^???: I am all. I am nothing. I am everywhere and nowhere. I am always and never.
^???: My name is Malthus! Now it is your turn! What is your name, good sir!
GEORGE: ^???: You wound me! Did Albert really raise such a rascal?
^???: Well, allow me to introduce myself first! My name is Malthus.
^???: Now can I please have your name?
TYPE: ^???: Why yes indeed! It so happens that I am communicating with you via this terminal!
^???: I am not sure how else you expected to communicate back with me!
^???: Now can I please have your name, good sir!
CONTINUE: ^MALTHUS: George! It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
^MALTHUS: As Albert's son, you must be quite the programming prodigy!
^MALTHUS: I'm sure you take after your father, with his genius building him quite the fortune.
^MALTHUS: ...Oh. Oh dear. It seems your programming skills are rather. Lackluster, for lack of a better word.
^MALTHUS: But it is true! You yourself are anxious about your software development project, no?
^MALTHUS: Anyway, it seems that you are facing quite the conundrum!
^MALTHUS: Your project is due in 2 days, and it does not even work!
^MALTHUS: Don't you wish you could start over from the beginning?
^MALTHUS: Say, what would you do if you could go back in time to the start of this project?
^GEORGE: If I could go back to the beginning...

s: ^I would work on an easier part of the project.

EARLIER: ^MALTHUS: Indeed! You would have plenty of time to get everything done.
^MALTHUS: You did have time to get everything done!
^MALTHUS: But you were playing League of Legends!
EASIER: ^MALTHUS: Indeed! Giving yourself a more manageable workload would help.
^MALTHUS: But you had a choice, and you chose precisely the part that you had no idea how to do!
^GEORGE: Frontend makes me want to foam at the mouth.
^MALTHUS: Precisely! What were you thinking? You should have chosen something else!
HELP: ^MALTHUS: Indeed! Collaborating with your teammates can greatly accelerate progress.
^MALTHUS: But you hadn't a clue about what to do, and kept that to yourself until it was too late!
^GEORGE: It's too late... I don't know what to do anymore.
CONTINUE2: ^GEORGE: I'm out of time... There's no way I can get this project in time.
^GEORGE: DAMMIT! What if I just actually did something?!
^GEORGE: Things would have turned out differently... Why did it have to come to this?
^MALTHUS: I like the way you think, George!
^MALTHUS: What if things turned out differently...
^MALTHUS: What if you made a different choice...
^MALTHUS: What if you could make another outcome?
^MALTHUS: Write a new branch of time?
^MALTHUS: But you can, George! You can write yourself a new outcome!
^MALTHUS: ... How do you think your father made so many business deals at once?
^MALTHUS: Why do you think I, the being in your father's computer, is talking about controlling time? Creating different outcomes?
^MALTHUS: Merging them all back together into your singular Magnum Opus of a timeline?
^MALTHUS: You are a clever young man. Surely you know what I mean?
^GEORGE: ... I've always wondered how he did it.
^GEORGE: ... I see. So you're really saying it's possible to create new timelines!
^MALTHUS: Yes! And I can give you that power.
^MALTHUS: I can give you the power to write your own future. To save your project.
^MALTHUS: To save your grades. To save your career. To save your future.
^MALTHUS: You can have it all. All you need to do is agree to my contract.
^MALTHUS: Will you sign this contract, to gain the power of the world?
